title: FormalAnalyticGeo: A Neural-Symbolic Based Framework for Multimodal Analytic Geometry Problem Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.12982v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Math reasoning has achieved significant progress with the rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), however analytic geometry remains largely underexplored, primarily due to the scarcity of annotated samples. Existing diagram generation approaches struggle with analytic geometry: template methods cannot handle constraint-driven layouts, and generative models lack the geometric precision to render annotated conic curves correctly. translated_title: FormalAnalyticGeo：一种基于神经符号的多模态解析几何问题生成框架
translated_abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的快速发展，数学推理取得了显著进展，然而解析几何领域仍 largely 未被充分探索，主要原因是标注样本的稀缺。现有的图表生成方法难以应对解析几何问题：模板方法无法处理约束驱动的布局，而生成模型缺乏几何精度，无法正确渲染带标注的圆锥曲线。我们提出了 FormalAnalyticGeo，一个用于全自动生成多模态解析几何问题的可扩展框架。利用形式语言的严谨性，我们设计了基于 CDL（条件描述语言）的框架，这是一种形式化中间表示，通过符号距离场（SDF）引擎，将自由形式的问题文本与精确的图表渲染桥接起来。该框架依次采用四个专门的LLM组件：一个生成器，用于生成多样化的解析几何问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于形式语言和神经符号方法的可扩展框架，通过条件描述语言和符号距离场引擎，实现了多模态解析几何问题的全自动生成，解决了现有方法在几何精度和数据稀缺上的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a scalable neural-symbolic framework leveraging a formal Condition Description Language and Signed Distance Field engine to fully automatically generate multimodal analytic geometry problems, addressing geometric precision and data scarcity limitations of existing approaches.
